content.title: 3 Insurance Stocks We Think Twice About
content.summary: Insurance companies serve as the backbone of risk management, providing essential protection and financial security for individuals and businesses. Still, investors are uneasy as insurers face challenges from catastrophic events and potential regulatory changes. These doubts have certainly contributed to insurance stocks’ recent underperformance - over the past six months, the industry’s 3.6% gain has fallen behind the S&P 500’s 13.9% rise.
